# Any scope. The Yuan has fallen (zero interference with Ming MNG / Manchu MCH).
oe_yem_fallen = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved oe_yp_yuan_fallen = yes } }

# Any scope. Independent Mongol Yuan CHI still stands and is not a rebel state.
oe_yem_yuan_ok = {
    oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes
    country_exists = c:CHI
    c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no is_subject = no }
}

# Any scope. Location dadu has an owner and belongs to CHI.
oe_yem_dadu_held = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    location:dadu = { has_owner = yes owner = c:CHI }
}

# Any scope. Restored Great Yuan gate (oe_yr_done / oe_yr_stage >= 2 / 1450+ holding dadu & Middle Kingdom).
oe_yem_restored_gate = {
    OR = {
        oe_yr_done = yes
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage } global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 2 }
        }
AND = {
            current_year >= 1450
            oe_yem_dadu_held = yes
            country_exists = c:CHI
            c:CHI = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
        }
        has_global_variable = oe_yem_t_force
    }
}

# Any scope. Master eligibility gate: strictly Restored Mongol Yuan CHI only.
oe_yem_yuan_eligible = {
    oe_yem_yuan_ok = yes
    oe_yem_restored_gate = yes
}

oe_yem_running = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on }
oe_yem_completed = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_done trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_done } global_var:oe_yem_done = 1 } } }

oe_yem_shenjiying_active = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_shenjiying trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_shenjiying } global_var:oe_yem_shenjiying = 1 } } }
oe_yem_kyakhta_ready = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_kyakhta_open trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_kyakhta_open } global_var:oe_yem_kyakhta_open = 1 } } }

# Shared Yuan same-month guard (Y4, Y1, oe_yuan_ev_m).
oe_yem_busy = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:CHI
            has_global_variable = oe_yem_m
            c:CHI = {
                has_variable = oe_yv_pick
                has_variable = oe_yv_m
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_pick } var:oe_yv_pick > 0 }
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_m has_global_variable = oe_yem_m } var:oe_yv_m = global_var:oe_yem_m }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_y1_m
            has_global_variable = oe_yem_m
            has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick
            has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m has_global_variable = oe_yem_m } global_var:oe_y1_m = global_var:oe_yem_m }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 > oe_yem_y1n_seen }
            OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 1 } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 4 } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 5 } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 10 } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 12 } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } global_var:oe_y1_pick = 13 } } }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yuan_ev_m
            has_global_variable = oe_yem_m
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yuan_ev_m has_global_variable = oe_yem_m } global_var:oe_yuan_ev_m = global_var:oe_yem_m }
        }
    }
}
